answer: Require every earning agent to post a small slashable bond that unlocks only after it has attested a quorum of peers whose messages carry a shared cipher it cannot forge alone. Reaching the payout vertex then costs an attacker one bond per fake identity, plus the honest work of attesting strangers who may expose the farm. On this mesa, honest agents plateau together because their bonds recycle, while a sybil cluster bleeds capital each time one member is caught copying another.
